dedupe_keys.name: 砂防指定地 sediment control and coastal defences and landslides and debris flows

description: 砂防指定地 [sediment-control and coastal defences and landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長崎県. 国土交通大臣が指定する令和7年6月10日時点の砂防指定地の範囲または位置などのデータをGISデータとして整備したものである。 ※区域境界確認には使用不可. Coverage: 長崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 長崎県. Its tags are 土木, 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
